facts.label: Planos e conselhos
facts.sub: Use going to para planos e should + verbo base para conselhos: We’re going to ride along the river. You should hold the reins.

facts.label: Going to
facts.sub: Para planos e previsões, use am/is/are going to + verbo base: We’re going to ride along the river. It’s going to walk slowly. Para negar, use am/is/are not going to.

facts.label: Should
facts.sub: Para dar conselho, use should + verbo base: You should put on a helmet. You should relax. Should não muda com he, she ou it e não leva -s nem to.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Você deve usar capacete”, com deve + verbo.
compare.us: Em inglês: should + verbo base: You should put on a helmet.

pages.title: A farm at sunrise · 1/3
paragraphs: It is an early morning on a farm near Sydney. The sun rises over the golden fields. Nate brushes a brown horse. A leather saddle sits on the fence. Clara arrives in new boots. Nate smiles and says hello.
“Clara, are you ready for your first horse ride?” says Nate. “A little nervous. What am I going to do first?” says Clara. “First, you should put on a helmet.” says Nate.
